So the eye, the yaw and the light are the 1898 camera's, unchanged; the focal length is its 1468.9 px times 1.00489, and the principal point its (619.0, 412.2) mapped through the fit. Every caveat of that solve carries over with it, the eye's distance first (50-70 m out fit within 3-4 px).
